en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a long paddle steamer full of passengers moving along a river in the foreground. On the steep bank behind it rises a large hilltop complex of Gothic and medieval-looking buildings with towers and spires, resembling a cathedral and castle ensemble. Below the hill stand smaller riverside houses and commercial buildings. The steamer's stern bears a clearly visible name, and there is a painted riverside advertisement on one of the buildings.
